claimsToVerify: The magindara are water spirits (sirena) of Visayan folklore said to dwell near coral reefs and lure fishermen with their singing
Visayan fisherfolk traditionally make offerings (halad) of tuba or food to the sea before casting their nets
In the lore, each reef is said to have its own magindara song, and specific reefs are avoided because of fishermen said to have drowned there
